title.narrative: Defending Media Freedom and Strengthening Climate Reporting SDG Project (Pub 360 - 23/27303)

description.narrative:
In recent years, Ghana's once-strong reputation for press freedom has experienced a significant decline, raising serious concerns about the commitment to freedom of speech as a fundamental human right enshrined in the Ghanaian Constitution and upheld by global commitments. There is also a proliferation of misinformation and disinformation, fake news, which is a growing concern and has the potential to impact the 2024 elections. Given these developments, this project will provide small-scale grant support to national civil society organisations to facilitate dialogue and collaboration among stakeholders to improve the press freedom environment and combat the spread of fake news. This intervention for SDG 16 (Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions) aims to empower relevant stakeholders to engage in open dialogues aimed at shaping the National Action Plan and addressing the issue of fake news.
Despite the severe impact of climate change in Ghana and the Government’s active profile during the international climate negotiations, climate does not take up a lot of space in the media and is seldom debated in the public, where instead issues like the current economic crisis take up most of the media picture. There is a need for strengthening climate reporting in Ghana through training of journalists on this specific area, as well as increasing awareness among especially the youth about the impact of climate change and government’s policies and position on the implementation of these policies, as well as the overall coherence in the climate policies (for instance expansion of production of fossil fuels vs. introduction of renewable energy capacity). These activities are an important contribution towards the achievement of SDG 13 (Climate Action). The project will also provide small-scale grant support to strengthen climate reporting and increase awareness among the population, especially the youth about the impact of climate change

To strengthen the dialogue by Ghanaian media stakeholders regarding the content of a National Action Plan to promote media freedom; strengthen young people’s engagement and awareness of fake news, misinformation, impact of government policies about climate change; strengthen climate reporting.
